description: Every Zammad ticket, article, and Knowledge Base operation as one agent-native CLI — plus a team-management layer (agent load, customer health, aging backlog, escalation triage, churn risk, feedback mining) the Zammad API can't answer in a single call.

novel_features.name: Ticket volume by agent
novel_features.description: See each agent's current ticket load broken out by state (open/pending/backlog) so you can balance work before it piles up.

novel_features.name: Agent open/closed trend
novel_features.description: Show whether each agent's queue is growing or shrinking across the last N weeks, with opened-vs-closed deltas.

novel_features.name: Customer health indicators
novel_features.description: Rank organizations by a health signal built from open count, oldest-open age, reopen rate, velocity, and last activity.

novel_features.name: Tickets open too long
novel_features.description: Find aging tickets still in new/open/pending past a threshold, weighted by priority so the worst rise to the top.

novel_features.name: Escalation sentiment triage
novel_features.description: Surface active tickets whose recent customer messages read as upset (heuristic negative-signal scan), ranked by hits, age, and priority — with the matched snippets shown.

novel_features.name: Proactive churn risk
novel_features.description: Score each organization's churn risk from open backlog, overdue tickets, unanswered pending, and negative-sentiment customer messages, listing the contributing factors.

novel_features.name: Feedback mining
novel_features.description: Bucket ticket and article text into feature-request, pricing, compliance, and bug themes with the source ticket refs and snippets.

novel_features.name: Knowledge Base browse
novel_features.description: Print the Knowledge Base as a category/answer tree parsed from the init bundle.

novel_features.name: Knowledge Base search
novel_features.description: Offline text search over KB answer titles and bodies from the init bundle.

novel_features.name: Knowledge Base get answer
novel_features.description: Resolve a KB answer id from the init bundle to its full translated body.

novel_features.name: Add ticket note
novel_features.description: Add an internal or partner-visible note to a ticket in one line, with correct content-type defaults.
